title: MenuBip
description: Publish a public QR menu, take dine-in, takeaway, and delivery orders, and run restaurant POS ops — from signup to kitchen ticket.
meta_description: MenuBip by OCMONO: QR menus, live ordering, kitchen routing, and restaurant POS. See features and pricing.

capabilities_json.title: Your menu URL
capabilities_json.description: Claim a username — guests open app.menubip.com/your-username via QR.

capabilities_json.title: Orders to kitchen
capabilities_json.description: Route dine-in, takeaway, and delivery tickets to kitchen displays.

capabilities_json.title: One dashboard
capabilities_json.description: Edit dishes, manage tables, capture guests, and watch live service.

capabilities_json.title: Razorpay billing
capabilities_json.description: Pay with UPI / PhonePe and unlock plans from the dashboard.

capabilities_json.title: POS & GST
capabilities_json.description: Day-end close, Z-reports, GST invoices, stock purchasing on Pro+.

capabilities_json.title: Multi-property
capabilities_json.description: Enterprise tools for loyalty, events, custom domains, and multi-outlet control.

saas_meta_json.audience: Restaurants, cafés, hotels, and multi-outlet F&B brands
saas_meta_json.problem: Paper menus and scattered order channels slow service. Guests want to scan, order, and pay without installing another app.

deep_features.title: From QR scan to kitchen
deep_features.text: Guests browse and order without an app install. Tickets route live so front of house and kitchen stay aligned.

deep_features.title: Plans for every stage
deep_features.text: Start with a polished QR menu, then unlock ordering, POS, GST, and multi-property as you grow.

deep_features.title: Built for busy service
deep_features.text: Tables, discounts, guest capture, WhatsApp alerts, and analytics keep service nights under control.

pricing.note: Paid plans unlock in the MenuBip dashboard via Razorpay. Prices in ₹ / month.

faqs.a: No. Guests open your public menu URL from a QR code — no install required.
Register on app.menubip.com, pick a username and plan, then share your QR menu.

faqs.q: What payments are supported for billing?
faqs.a: Plan upgrades use Razorpay with UPI (including PhonePe) and other supported methods.
